notes.title: Hexpire Demo V2
notes.notes:
Hexpire's Demo's first major update just happened! Here is everything new:

Calculated Values won't be shown by default(There is a setting called Easy Mode to change this)
Hexes can only be placed if there next to at least 2 hexes.
Changed increase from *1.2 + 50 to *1.2 + 100
Added new building: School
Added 2 new camera controls
Added Overcrowding penalty
Added Help Menu
Made ships not Australian
***New save will be made automatically***

I have also made a Goal to add at least a building a week to the demo until I reach around 25

Thanks to everybody who played the demo! And if you like it don't forget to Wishlist it!

notes.title: Hexpire Demo Update
notes.notes:
Patch notes for Hexpire Demo V1.1

-Bug fixes:
    -Prevented extra building bug
    -Prevented extra hexagons bug
-New content:
    -Added Pyramid building
-Polish/Miscellaneous
    -Added more title screen openers
    -Added different colored productivity number for water producing buildings and money producing buildings
    -Edited City Hall ruleset
    -Edited Log Cabin ruleset
    -Added number pop up for amount of money made

And that updates Hexpire Demo V1.1!
